segmentName: Moneris Day End Batch Close (Request) Segment
scope: Segment 141 field-level rules for closing out each pay point to Moneris at day end

rules.title: Segment 141 is used to close out each pay point to Moneris; it should be sent once for each pay point at day end
All fields are separated by Field Separator characters
rules.note: Unlike Segment 139, Segment 141 explicitly documents full field separation — do not assume the two segments share identical wire format.

rules.title: Segment Type fixed 141, Segment Length 3 digits, both Device-sourced; all 14 fields (Terminal Identifier, SPDH Header, Moneris Terminal/Merchant ID, Batch Number, Language Indicator, Number/Dollar totals for debits/credits/corrections) are Device-sourced
rules.note: Contrast Segment 140 (response), where sourcing alternates between Device and Moneris — the request-side Segment 141 is uniformly Device-sourced.
